label: Keep File
description: Make a stored file last longer. A run's file is deleted when its run is (once the run's record goes), a project's when the project is, and any file at its deadline if it has one. `scope: project` (default) copies the file into the project's files and emits the NEW reference, so it outlives the run that made it (how an upload in one request is served by the next). `scope: run` leaves the file where it is and only sets its deadline. Any run can read any file either way. For a file not yet in storage (a URL), use FetchToStorage.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: A stored file, of any kind (`File`). Copied (original untouched) with `project`; left where it is with `run`.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.label: Keep as
inputs.description: `project`: copy it into the project's files, deleted with the project. `run`: leave it where it is, deleted with its own owner, and only set its deadline.

inputs.name: ttlDays
inputs.label: Deadline (idle days, empty or 0 = none)
inputs.description: The file is deleted once nobody has touched it for this many days (any read, download or link resets the count), or with its owner if that comes first. Empty or 0: no deadline, it lives as long as its scope says.

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: `project`: the NEW project copy (same name, type, size). `run`: the same reference, with its new deadline. The same kind that came in: a Video stays a Video.
